# Finance Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Finance department in the whole system: how well cost, budgeting, accounting, financial state, and runway hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Cost tracking and spend
- Budgeting and burn rate
- Accounting and financial records
- Financial state and runway
- Pricing economics and margins

## What is in place
- [ ] Lead agent for finance is named and active
- [ ] Skill that tracks costs and spend
- [ ] Skill that analyses financial state and runway
- [ ] Skill that advises on pricing economics
- [ ] Workflow that reviews spend before commitments are made
- [ ] Record of budgets, costs, and financial state in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Costs drift with no regular check
- [ ] Financial state is unclear when a decision needs it
- [ ] Runway is unknown or out of date
- [ ] Pricing is set without checking margins
- [ ] Financial records live in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real budget review and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
